_comment: Contract pin for MCP tool-name references inside common-skills SKILL.md files. Skills name tools in their workflow steps (e.g. `save_product_mappings`); if a tool is renamed in the webapp-server MCP registry and a skill still names the old identifier, the model is pointed at a dead tool. scripts/check_tool_contract.py fails CI when a skill references a tool-shaped identifier that is not in `valid_tools` (and not an explicitly allowed non-tool token).
_starter_note: This list is maintained by hand today. Hardening follow-up: have webapp-server emit its tool registry as a build artifact (tools.json) and publish it here so the pin can never drift from the deployed server. Until then, update `valid_tools` in the same PR that renames/adds/removes a tool.
